snippet.title: Nightmare: Reimagined Beginning - Trailer
snippet.description:
*Nightmare: Reimagined Beginning* is a remake of my first game Nightmare. The game was made completely from scratch and the old stuff that appeared here was recreated and refreshed. If you are one of those people who have been waiting for this, thank you from the bottom of my heart.

*Link to game:* https://gamejolt.com/games/nightmare_reimagined_beginning/529235

Music used in the trailer: 
*Medative Rain* by SoundsForYou
*Playing in Color* by Nullhertz
*R&b* by Music For Videos
